'''R5-D5'''<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/mwbtmmq7h4q3k3h39cvng8|text=JTF-FF-001190|date=2022-06-06}}</ref> was an [[R5 series astromech droid]]<ref name="Kenobi3Audio" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|III}}</ref> the [[R-series]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> [[astromech droid]] was operating on the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]]-controlled [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]], where it worked alongside the [[loader droid]] [[NED-B]] on a landing pad atop a flat mesa.<ref name="Kenobi3" />

Both [[droid]]s were present when the [[TR-286 transport]]<ref name="Kenobi3" /> designated [[transport eight]]<ref name="Kenobi2">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> arrived<ref name="Kenobi3" /> from the planet [[Daiyu]].<ref name="Kenobi2" /> As the [[Starship|ship's]] droids began to unload its cargo, NED-B gestured to R5-D5, who stood next to<ref name="Kenobi3" /> a communications silo.<ref name="Kenobi3Audio" /> The astromech droid then turned to the silo as the stowaways [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] snuck out of transport eight behind the droids' backs. R5-D5 had [[Color|pink]]-and-white plating, black [[sensor]]s,<ref name="Kenobi3" /> and stood ninety-seven [[centimeter]]s tall.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-D5 appeared in the [[Part III|third episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series,<ref name="Kenobi3" /> which aired on [[June 1]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}}</ref> The droid was identified in official promotional assets linked to the show released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] via [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] on [[June 6]], 2022.<ref name="Getty" />
